scope: Collect unfiltered exact-name, subgenus-normalized and recorded-synonym candidates from retained versioned source archives. Identity, synonymy, family, missing-value conventions, historical boundaries and field-specific provenance still need review. Candidate availability is not biological concept equivalence, completed prose or full-text reading.

unmatchedCOL.gapReason: No biological archive or non-taxonomy reference located by this bounded collection pass; this is not a finding that sources do not exist.
unmatchedCOL.nextAction: Collect species-specific biological sources; resolve historical name/concept matches before reuse.
